entries.title: Psalms 91:1
segments: ¶He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

entries.title: Psalms 91:2
segments: I will say of the LORD, "[He is] my refuge and my fortress; My God, in Him I will trust."

entries.title: Psalms 91:3
segments: Surely He shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler [And] from the perilous pestilence.

entries.title: Psalms 91:4
segments: He shall cover you with His feathers, And under His wings you shall take refuge; His truth [shall be your] shield and buckler.

entries.title: Psalms 91:5
segments: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, [Nor] of the arrow [that] flies by day,

entries.title: Psalms 91:6
segments: [Nor] of the pestilence [that] walks in darkness, [Nor] of the destruction [that] lays waste at noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 91:7
segments: A thousand may fall at your side, And ten thousand at your right hand; [But] it shall not come near you.

entries.title: Psalms 91:8
segments: Only with your eyes shall you look, And see the reward of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 91:9
segments: ¶Because you have made the LORD, [who is] my refuge, [Even] the Most High, your dwelling place,

entries.title: Psalms 91:10
segments: No evil shall befall you, Nor shall any plague come near your dwelling;

entries.title: Psalms 91:11
segments: For He shall give His angels charge over you, To keep you in all your ways.

entries.title: Psalms 91:12
segments: In [their] hands they shall bear you up, Lest you dash your foot against a stone.

entries.title: Psalms 91:13
segments: You shall tread upon the lion and the cobra, The young lion and the serpent you shall trample underfoot.

entries.title: Psalms 91:14
segments: "Because he has set his love upon Me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he has known My name.

entries.title: Psalms 91:15
segments: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I [will be] with him in trouble; I will deliver him and honor him.

entries.title: Psalms 91:16
segments: With long life I will satisfy him, And show him My salvation."
